The background is filled with grand crystal chandeliers hanging from a high ceiling, and empty round dining tables set with white cloths and blue chairs. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @Lilyflute. [Slogan]: Flute Warm-up Transposing the Theme from Liszt's "La Campanella" (Grandes Études de Paganini No.3). [Slogan]: 跟著長笛姐姐暖身練習｜李斯特《鐘》主題旋律移調挑戰. (2) [Subtitle]: 這是表演前的暖身練習之一 One of my backstage warm-ups before performance. (3) [Subtitle]: 之前在 Berklee 的時候，有位老師曾對我說：「踏出即興奏的第一步，就是練習移調。」 Back in Berklee, one of my professors told me, "The very first step to improvisation is practicing modulation." (4) [Subtitle]: 所以我從李斯特《鐘》的原調開始半音半音往上。 So I start from the original key of Liszt's "La Campanella" and go up half step by half step. (5) [Subtitle]: 越往上音越高，除了要對抗與原調越來越遠的違和感，也考驗長笛演奏進入更偏僻的高音的音準。 The higher it goes, the further it drifts from the original key - and the higher the flute register becomes, you have to rethink them with enharmonic fingerings. (6) [Subtitle]: 讓自己已經習慣 12 個不同調性的指法，沒有捷徑。 It also makes me face all 12 keys - no shortcuts, no hiding. (7) [Subtitle]: 有些調吹起來感覺很一成不變，用手中的長笛尋找它最溫潤的共鳴。 Some keys feel completely unnatural - you have to rethink them with enharmonic fingerings. (8) [Subtitle]: 也是逼自己練習高音指法。 It forces me to push my high-note fingerings. (9) [Subtitle]: 移調使人謙遜。因為永遠有學不完、練不完的東西。 Transposition keeps you humble - because there's always more to learn and more to practice. (10) [Subtitle]: 你也拿起樂器試試看吧! Why don't you give it a try too?

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a musical performance and educational piece demonstrating a flute warm-up technique based on Liszt's 'La Campanella'. The flutist uses the exercise to explain the importance of transposition and finger dexterity, aiming to share her professional practice routine with other musicians.
